name: CITIC Resources Holdings Limited
summary: CITIC Resources Holdings Limited (CRHL), established in 1997 and based in Kowloon, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company and subsidiary of CITIC Group Corporation that explores for and develops oil and coal. It reports aluminum smelting, coal, commodity import and export, and crude oil divisions. Aluminum comes from the Portland smelter in Australia, coal is mined and sold only in Australia, and crude oil operations are in Indonesia and China. It also does financial services, property and consulting.
